dataset: Fleeting - Set a Watch (Nashville closing-watchlist feed)
methodology: Each spot is a time-limited Nashville window the Fleeting crawl tracks, with a real, parseable close date. A spot stays listed while it is open and for 30 days after it closes, so a saved watch for a just-closed spot still resolves honestly; undated/prose timing is never promoted to a date and is not listed. 'days_left' and 'status' are counted from the as_of date; a reader's page recomputes them against the reader's own clock when opened. This is a PULL status feed, not a notification channel: nothing here is ever sent.

status_values.on_watch: open, closes in more than 7 days
